_doc: Defaults used ONLY by the 3D reconstruction when the plan does not specify a value. Every default use is recorded in the 3D metadata.

ground._doc: Floor coverage (topology/ground.py): parts of the building outline (closed over notches up to 2 x close_m) not covered by rooms, walls or columns get a ground slab and a validation warning. A piece counts only when at least min_structure_share of its edge runs along a live wall, room or column.

_doc_balcony: Balcony walls (classification 'railing'): a low solid parapet of balcony_parapet_height_m with glass above it up to railing_height_m.
_doc_stack_levels: Multi-storey permit sets: true = floors moved onto each other at their levels; false = every floor plan stays where it is drawn, side by side at ground level.

level_slabs._doc: Stacked storeys (topology/level_slabs.py, reconstruction3d/builder.py): every floor-plan level gets a base slab and a roof slab over its closed outline. A plan that does not close (its closed shape covers less than min_hull_share of the hull of its walls) gets the outline that connects the outer vertices of its walls (concave hull with hull_ratio; 1 = convex). Levels whose name matches no_roof_names keep their top open (attic / roof storeys: their roof shape is not a flat slab). The storeys of a building repeat: the part of a storey's outline further than max_overhang_m beyond every other storey is cut (the lowest storey is kept; null = no limit).

pitched_roof._doc: Attic / roof storeys (level name matches level_slabs.no_roof_names) get a pitched hip roof (reconstruction3d/roof.py). Outline: the roof plan of the drawing when it has one (areas hatched with a roof-tile pattern: hatch_patterns are matched in the hatch pattern and layer name; the untiled middle is a hole), else the storey's walled part; never wider than the storey below plus overhang_m. Shape: every side of the outline carries a plane rising inwards at pitch_deg, starting knee_wall_m above the attic floor and rising at most to the storey height (max_height_m overrides; above it the roof is flat). The attic's walls, columns and glazing are trimmed under the slope. tile: the roof surface is laid in courses of tiles (course_m exposed length up the slope, each course standing thickness_m proud at its lower edge), coloured alternately with colors.
